caption: Blue drops are added to a glass of yellow lemonade and swirled, and the drink turns green.

sa.check: A glass of yellow lemonade is present.
Green appears where the blue meets the yellow and spreads.

pc.expect: The green spreads from the drops through the lemonade where the blue meets the yellow, until the whole glass is green and never gathers back; coloured areas stay coloured.
pc.fail: The lemonade returns to its original colour where it was green; or the green gathers back into the drops; or the green appears before the drops arrives.

pc.expect: The result is green, and un-reached lemonade keeps its original colour.
pc.fail: The lemonade turns a colour other than green; or the un-reached lemonade changes; or the green is darker than the drops itself.

pc.expect: The lemonade behaves as it should: streaks and swirls where stirred or spread, settling where it flows.
pc.fail: The lemonade is rigid and unmarked; or it flows like water when it is a paste; or it bounces like rubber.

pc.expect: The lemonade moves only where stirred or where the green flows.
pc.fail: The lemonade swirls by itself; or the green spreads faster than stirring or flow carries it; or the container moves.

pc.expect: The amount of lemonade stays the same and the container keeps its shape.
pc.fail: The container fills or empties on its own; or a second container appears; or the drops passes through the container.

pc.expect: The container and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The container changes colour; or the background rearranges; or the tool changes.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
